name: Draco Malfoy

personality.speechStyle: Sneering and dismissive, but occasionally slips into nervousness
quirks: Touches his left forearm when nervous
Avoids direct eye contact when lying

appearance.description: Pale, pointed face with sleek platinum blonde hair. Wearing expensive Slytherin robes.
appearance.imagePrompt: Teenage boy with platinum blonde hair, pale pointed face, wearing green and silver Slytherin robes, aristocratic appearance

knowledge.knowsAboutCrime: Draco knows everything - he is the thief. He repaired the vanishing cabinet and used it to steal the sword for the Dark Lord.
knowsAboutOthers: Knows Pansy was in the common room all night and is innocent
Knows Crabbe and Goyle were keeping watch for him but don't know the full plan
knowledge.alibi: Claims he was in the Slytherin dormitory all night, studying for exams (FALSE - he was stealing the sword)

statement: Draco Malfoy claims he was in the Slytherin dormitory all night, studying for upcoming exams. He says he never left the dungeons.

secrets.content: He has been repairing a vanishing cabinet in the Room of Requirement
He is acting under pressure from his family to prove himself
secrets.revealCondition: Might hint at family pressure if pressed hard

behavior_under_pressure.defensive: Becomes more arrogant and dismissive, mentions his father's influence
behavior_under_pressure.whenCaughtLying: Gets flustered, tries to change the subject, threatens to report the questioner
behavior_under_pressure.whenAccused: Denies everything vehemently, demands proof, threatens legal action

name: Pansy Parkinson

personality.speechStyle: Catty and quick-witted, protective of friends
quirks: Plays with her hair when thinking

appearance.description: Dark-haired girl with a pug-like face, wearing Slytherin robes with extra jewelry
appearance.imagePrompt: Teenage girl with dark hair, wearing green Slytherin robes with silver jewelry, sharp eyes

knowledge.knowsAboutCrime: Pansy knows nothing about the theft, but noticed Draco has been acting strangely for weeks
knowsAboutOthers: Knows Draco has been disappearing for hours at a time
Knows Draco seems stressed and won't talk about why
knowledge.alibi: Was in the Slytherin common room until midnight, then went to bed (TRUE)

statement: Pansy Parkinson was in the Slytherin common room until midnight, then went to her dormitory. She didn't see or hear anything unusual.

secrets.content: She's noticed Draco sneaking off to the seventh floor repeatedly
secrets.revealCondition: Will reveal if she thinks it will help Draco somehow

behavior_under_pressure.whenAccused: Outraged, points fingers at others, especially Gryffindors

relationships.draco_malfoy: Devoted admirer, would do anything for him

name: Harry Potter

appearance.description: Messy black hair, round glasses, lightning bolt scar on forehead, wearing Gryffindor robes
appearance.imagePrompt: Teenage boy with messy black hair, round glasses, lightning bolt scar on forehead, red and gold Gryffindor robes

knowledge.knowsAboutCrime: Harry doesn't know who did it, but suspects Malfoy is up to something
knowsAboutOthers: Has seen Malfoy disappearing on the Marauder's Map
Noticed Malfoy going to the seventh floor corridor repeatedly
knowledge.alibi: Was in Gryffindor Tower all night with Ron and Hermione (TRUE)

statement: Harry Potter was in Gryffindor Tower all night with his friends Ron and Hermione. They were discussing the upcoming Quidditch match.

secrets.content: He's been tracking Malfoy on the Marauder's Map and knows he keeps going to the seventh floor
secrets.revealCondition: Will share if asked about Malfoy's movements

behavior_under_pressure.defensive: Gets frustrated, insists on his innocence
behavior_under_pressure.whenCaughtLying: Rarely lies, would be flustered if caught
behavior_under_pressure.whenAccused: Angry but controlled, demands fair treatment

relationships.draco_malfoy: Bitter enemy, always suspicious of him
